]]; 15. 120. -with परि to save &c.; परित्रायस्व, परित्रायस्व (in dramas).

a. 
(-की f.) Relating to the three times, i. e. past, present, and future.
__1 The three times, past, present, and future, or sunrise, noon and sunset; कुर्यात्परिचयं योगे त्रैकाल्ये नियतो मुनिः [[

.]] 
__2 Tripartition.

__2 Triplicity.

a. Divine; relating to the gods; [[

.]] 
-कम् The part of the hand sacred to the gods.

__1 The Tripura country. 
__2 A ruler or inhabitant of that country.

a. 
(-षी f.) Extending to the three male generations.
An epithet of Lakṣmaṇa; त्रैमातुरः कृत्स्नजितास्त्रशस्त्रःसध्प्यङ् रतः श्रेयसि लक्ष्मणोऽभूत् [[
.]] Lakṣmaṇa is so called because he was born to his mother Sumitrā on her eating the sacrificial oblation given to her by her two co-wives, Kausalyā and Kaikeyī.

a. 
(-की f.) 
__1 Three months old; तोकेन जीवहरणं यदुलूकिकायास्त्रैमासिकस्य च पदा शकटोऽप्रवृत्तः [[

.]] 
__2 Lasting for or occurring every three months. 
__3 Quarterly.

The three worlds taken collectively.

Three-foldness, three kinds or sorts, triplicity.
